name: B10-0571/2025 (PPE) – Continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns Belarus for sending balloons, drones and migrants into Lithuania and for threatening Lithuanian trucks. It says these are deliberate hostile acts, backed by Russia, and that an attack on one EU country is an attack on all. It asks for tougher sanctions on Belarus, support for Lithuania's right to shoot down threatening objects, and better EU air defences. This is the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament calls for tougher sanctions, EU air defence and support for Lithuania.
- **Who is affected:** Lithuania and its neighbours, Belarus, Russia, EU governments and travellers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and Council are asked to act on sanctions and defence plans.
